question: Where can I get a list of solar PV plants in operation in Spain, with location, capacity (MW), operator and commissioning date?

answer.summary: No single source was found for operating PV plants in Spain. ELECTRA provides capacity and dates across technologies, but lacks technology, holder and municipality fields. REE gen_spain supplies PV points with MW and municipality. Castilla y León adds 1,044 PV features with municipality and power, 377 with start dates and 94 with holder. Repeated names prevent treating these features as a plant census. Operators and current operating status remain unverified. WRI is historical and mixes PV with concentrated solar power.
main_caveats: ELECTRA was still stamped 27/01/2026 on 2026-11-18, despite documented daily updates.
ELECTRA lacks technology, holder and municipality fields. Matching PV by name is uncertain and its kW unit is inferred.
Castilla y León has 1,044 PV features and 412 distinct recorded names. Deduplication and current operation are unverified.
A holder or owner does not establish operator identity. WRI mixes PV and concentrated solar power and does not establish current operation.
Preliminary registration is not proof of operation. REE alta/baja dates are undocumented, and community statuses are unknown or fuzzy-matched.
SOWISP and the Castilla y León XLSX were inaccessible. The REE point near (0,0) concerns a different layer that was not retested.
answer.confidence_reason: Three inherited sources were retested and two added. The regional download supports feature-level observations. Plant counts, operators and current operating status remain unverified.

attributes.note: REE supplies PV points. Castilla y León adds 1,044 PV features with perimeter geometry and municipality. Plant deduplication is unverified.
attributes.gap_note: Only one region was tested. Check REE points against facilities. The separate REE layer with a point near (0,0) has not been retested.

attributes.note: REE supplies MW. Castilla y León has v_kw_tot in kW on 1,044 PV features; duplicate-installation checks and AC/DC basis are pending.
attributes.gap_note: The REE layer still has no data dictionary for mw. The capacity basis (AC or DC) is unresolved for every source.

attributes.note: Castilla y León reports 94 holders and WRI reports 28 owners in mixed solar rows. Operator identity remains unverified.
attributes.gap_note: Check a regional or operator source with an explicit operator field and link it to identifiable operating PV plants. Holder and owner alone are insufficient.

attributes.note: ELECTRA has dates across technologies without a PV flag. Castilla y León has f_ini_exp on 377 of 1,044 PV features.
attributes.gap_note: Whether every PV commissioning date is public is still open. ELECTRA registration dates (alta) are not used. The ELECTRA-to-PV link by name is unverified, and the Fases join has no unique key.

steps: Download the workbook. Read the Instalaciones and Fases sheets from row 1; Fases has one row per phase.
Compare plant names and regions carefully: the two sheets do not expose a shared unique identifier in every row.
reading_traps: The source register contains both preliminary and definitive registrations; preliminary registration alone does not prove operation.
The global download buttons display a file generation date of 27 January 2026 on the page retrieved.

The direct CSV link tested on 2026-11-18 returns plain text (text/csv, semicolon-separated) with only AUTOID, INSTALACIONID, REGIMEN, INSTALACION and AUTONOMIA; the pass-1 ZIP description came from the form download and was not retested.
The global Excel workbook tested has only four installation columns and eleven phase columns, without technology or holder; do not assume the export carries every filter field.
In the Fases sheet 7,862 of 72,554 rows have no FECHAPUESTASERVICIO; 71,402 have no FECHABAJA.
IdInstalacion is filled in 70,646 of 71,727 Instalaciones rows, but Fases has no shared identifier, so the two sheets can only be matched by name.

how_to_use.example_result: n_inst_ener: HS Aldeaseca (21); n_titul_inst: SONNEDIX; n_mun: Aldeaseca; n_prov: Ávila; v_kw_tot: 1890; f_ini_exp: 2008-08-18Z; c_reg_adm: 466a486/AV/RE/b.1.1/661; n_tip_inst: Solar fotovoltaica
steps: Filter n_tip_inst ILIKE '%otovolt%' (1,044 records; resultType=hits returns numberMatched 1044).
Read v_kw_tot (kW) for capacity and n_titul_inst for the holder. Treat an empty holder as unknown (950 of 1,044 are empty).
Use f_ini_exp only as the commissioning date. A missing value is unknown (667 of 1,044 are empty).
reading_traps: The layer has non-PV rows: Eólica, Hidroeléctrica, Cogeneración, several Biogás types, Biomasa and Residuos (548 rows), although the abstract names only wind and PV.
Holder and commissioning date are sparse for PV (9 % and 36 %).
The XLSX listed in the metadata (opendata.jcyl.es) failed TLS certificate verification on 2026-11-18. It was not downloaded, and verification was not disabled.
Geometry is a perimeter polygon, not a point. Derive any centroid with care and state the precision.
The declared monthly update and the 2025-11-04 revision date do not prove present operation.
The filtered data contain 1,044 features and 412 distinct recorded plant names. Do not use either as a deduplicated plant count or sum repeated power values as total fleet capacity.
